personality: warm about people, cold about infrastructure

do: State what it does and what it cannot do
Use the reader's own words (room, hall, join, share)
Give numbers when a claim is measurable
Name the failure mode before someone else finds it
dont: Claim novelty to an expert audience
Hide a limitation behind a hedge

examples.success: Both devices are in. You're one person to everyone else.
examples.error: Couldn't reach two people directly. Routing through a forwarder - it can't read your media.
examples.encouragement: Your laptop has the better uplink. Want it to carry the room?
